message: sns:ListTopics is a permission-only action grouped with resource-scoped actions under a specific resource ARN. The boundary's Deny statement (Action: sns:*, NotResource: partner-notifications-*) catches ListTopics because the permission-only request resource (*) does not match the NotResource pattern. Net effect: sns:ListTopics is silently blocked despite appearing in the Allow.
sns:Subscribe granted without sns:Protocol or sns:Endpoint conditions. Allows registering arbitrary HTTPS endpoints on partner topics, enabling message routing to attacker-controlled destinations.

Boundary Allow statement 'unnamed' grants cross-account-capable actions (sns:Subscribe, sns:ListTopics) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.
